name: caul
description: A private AI overlay for live calls and screen work.

scripts.dev: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_CAUL_TRANSCRIPT_DEBUG_LOG=1 vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 CAUL_TRANSCRIPT_DEBUG_LOG=1 VITE_CAUL_TRANSCRIPT_DEBUG_LOG=1 electron ."
scripts.check: npm run check:shadcn && npm run build && npm test
scripts.package:prepare:mac: node scripts/assert-apple-silicon-macos-package.mjs && node scripts/verify-pi-licences.cjs && npm run generate-icons && npm run build && npm run desktop-backend:build:release && npm run macos-audio:build:release
scripts.package:prepare:win: node scripts/verify-pi-licences.cjs && npm run generate-icons && npm run build && npm run desktop-backend:build:release
scripts.package:prepare:linux: node scripts/verify-pi-licences.cjs && npm run generate-icons && npm run build && npm run desktop-backend:build:release
scripts.dist:mac:dev: cross-env FORCE_DEV_BUILD=true npm run package:prepare && cross-env FORCE_DEV_BUILD=true electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 --publish=never && node scripts/verify-macos-dev-package.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:dev:private: cross-env FORCE_DEV_BUILD=true FORCE_DEV_PRIVATE_BUILD=true npm run package:prepare && cross-env FORCE_DEV_BUILD=true FORCE_DEV_PRIVATE_BUILD=true electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --arm64 --publish=never && node scripts/verify-macos-dev-package.mjs --private
scripts.dist:win:arm64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run package:prepare:win && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs win arm64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:x64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run package:prepare:win && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs win x64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:dir:arm64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run package:prepare:win && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs win arm64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --arm64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:win:dir:x64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run package:prepare:win && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs win x64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win dir --x64 --publish=never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 npm run package:prepare:linux && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs linux arm64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish=never && node scripts/build-linux-deb.mjs arm64
scripts.dist:linux:x64: cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 npm run package:prepare:linux && node scripts/clean-package-output.mjs linux x64 && cross-env CAUL_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=linux CAUL_PACKAGE_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage rpm --x64 --publish=never && node scripts/build-linux-deb.mjs x64
scripts.smoke:electron: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && concurrently -k --success first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 CAUL_SMOKE_EXIT_MS=250 electron ."
scripts.smoke:electron:built: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && cross-env CAUL_SMOKE_EXIT_MS=250 electron .
scripts.smoke:renderer-llm: npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && cross-env CAUL_RENDERER_LLM_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.smoke:renderer-real-llm: npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && cross-env CAUL_RENDERER_REAL_LLM_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.smoke:resources: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && cross-env CAUL_RESOURCE_SMOKE_MS=3000 CAUL_RESOURCE_SMOKE_MAX_WORKING_SET_MB=450 electron .
scripts.smoke:onboarding: npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && node scripts/smoke-onboarding.mjs
scripts.smoke:onboarding-local-ai-lag: npm run build && npm run electron:sign-dev && node scripts/smoke-onboarding-local-ai-lag.mjs
scripts.smoke:system-audio: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && concurrently -k --success first "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && rm -f /tmp/caul-system-audio.out /tmp/caul-system-audio.err && open -n -W -o /tmp/caul-system-audio.out --stderr /tmp/caul-system-audio.err --env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 --env CAUL_SYSTEM_AUDIO_SMOKE_MS=8000 node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app --args \"$PWD\"; code=$?; cat /tmp/caul-system-audio.out 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/caul-system-audio.err 2>/dev/null; exit $code"
scripts.smoke:local-parakeet-browser-system-audi: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && node scripts/smoke-local-parakeet-browser-system-audio.mjs
scripts.smoke:local-parakeet-renderer-known-text: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && node scripts/smoke-local-parakeet-renderer-known-text.mjs
scripts.smoke:local-parakeet-start-offset: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && node scripts/smoke-local-parakeet-start-offset.mjs
scripts.bench:live-call-pipeline: npm run desktop-backend:build && npm run macos-audio:build && npm run electron:sign-dev && node scripts/bench-live-call-pipeline.mjs
scripts.electron:sign-dev: npm run electron:prepare-normal-mode && npm run electron:sign-local
scripts.electron:sign-dev-private: npm run electron:prepare-private-mode && npm run electron:sign-local
scripts.vm:e2e: npm run vm:e2e:macos && npm run vm:e2e:win && npm run vm:e2e:linux
